$comment: Per-component versions for the ad-page surface — the fold set harvested from the ad
landers built over roughly the last four to five months and drawn up in GW-Ads-Library.
That provenance is the point: these are not proposals, they are the folds that kept
getting used, which is why they earn their own library rather than being variants
version = the plugin version in which that component's spec last changed.
breaking = true when a build using it renders WRONG until updated.
STRUCTURE ONLY so far. Node ids, the Desktop/Phone split and every width and height
are node-traceable; no fill, radius, type style or token binding has been read off
these nodes yet. Everything here is therefore seeded at the version that first shipped
the measurement, not backdated to a release that predates the library.
Review state lives in the sibling `review` block, written by scripts/review-pass.sh.
check-drift.sh reads only ["components"], so that block is inert to it.
TWO ENTRIES ARE BUILT-HERE: ai-agents and comparison-table exist only as HTML in the
shipped lander, with no Figma component behind them. They carry provenance:'built-here'
and their measurement is in built-here.json rather than folds.json.
